title: Driftline
summary: An ocean-research decision workspace that makes portfolio bottlenecks, ownership gaps, and next actions visible.
intro: Driftline gives research teams a shared view of signals, evaluations, programs, and field operations—then routes attention to the decisions that will move the work forward.
role: Product strategy · Interaction design · Design system · Engineering

designSystem.name: Driftline
designSystem.summary: A portable product method expressed as a precise ocean-research instrument: calm enough to scan, explicit enough to act.

principles.name: Make flow visible
principles.description: Movement and blockage appear before secondary metrics so the state of the portfolio is immediately legible.

principles.name: Explain the prompt
principles.description: Every intervention names its rule, evidence, age, owner, and the condition that will clear it.

principles.name: Preserve human judgment
principles.description: The system routes attention while people retain responsibility for deciding, delegating, and offering support.

principles.name: Earn the density
principles.description: Compact operational information stays readable, structured, keyboard-accessible, and resilient at smaller viewports.

typography.description: A compact sans serif carries dense operational hierarchy without making the workspace feel administrative.
Rules, identifiers, stages, timestamps, and system status read like a precise research instrument.

components.name: Flow stage
components.description: A lifecycle node combines volume, stall count, median age, and filter state without hiding the underlying records.

components.name: Attention card
components.description: A decision unit exposes severity, reason, owner, elapsed time, evidence, and one contextual next action.

components.name: Role lens
components.description: The same portfolio reorganizes around four explicit responsibility boundaries without changing the underlying work.

components.name: Portfolio record
components.description: Signals, evaluations, programs, and operations share one searchable record grammar while retaining stage-specific evidence.

productProof.title: The handoff becomes the interface
productProof.description: Lifecycle flow, attention queues, and role lenses connect portfolio state to a specific person, explanation, and next action.

accessibility.title: Operational density remains navigable
accessibility.description: Native controls, visible labels, pressed states, 44px targets, reduced motion, forced-color support, and 200% reflow are treated as system constraints.

internalNotes: The public demo explicitly identifies its organization, people, and portfolio data as fictional. Confirm a source repository URL before publishing one.
